scope: One runtime-authored AC1027 DXF source with two root-reachable MLEADERSTYLE records. STANDARD has one existing group-90 INT32 maxLeaderPoints value 0 and an opaque group-302 tag; SECONDARY is unchanged. Supports a standalone typed maxLeaderPoints change from 0 to 7.

contract.admission: Source and target must both be AC1027. The selected record must be reachable through the validated ACAD_MLEADERSTYLE dictionary, have one source-matched raw body and immutable source baseline, and contain one existing group-90 INTEGER corresponding to parsed INT32 maxLeaderPoints. maxLeaderPoints must be the only changed typed payload field; table-entry identity, common fields, handles, application data, extension data and all other encoded style fields must match the source.
contract.projection: Replace only the existing physical group-90 value in a copy of the captured raw body using the ordinary INTEGER variant. Preserve all other ordered fields and opaque groups. Missing/repeated group 90, conflicting raw changes, simultaneous group-92 or DOUBLE edits, unknown subclass grammar and non-AC1027 routes remain outside this transaction. The INTEGER representation is required by the MLEADERSTYLE raw-record validator; the generic BodyWriter INTEGER64 special case for unsigned MATERIAL values is not reused.
contract.outputAndReadback: Inspect staged OBJECTS output against retained raw fields and mapped handles, then decode the emitted MLEADERSTYLE and require maxLeaderPoints to equal 7 while unchanged leaderLineWeight remains 25. Fresh readback checks both typed properties and exactly one literal group-90 INTEGER value 7. Both source encodings are exercised; output uses same-format and cross-format ASCII/binary paths.
contract.failureAndRetry: Changing captured raw group 90 from 0 to 1 while typed maxLeaderPoints requests 7 refuses and preserves a sentinel destination. A simultaneous group-92 leaderLineWeight edit refuses atomically. A late typed maxLeaderPoints mutation after preflight refuses without replacing the destination; restoring the requested value permits same-adapter retry. Exact field and fresh readback checks pass after retry.
contract.compatibility: Untouched MLEADERSTYLE records keep existing raw replay. Transactions are not admitted for other source or target versions, multiple changes on one record, or other integer fields. Typed DWG-origin writing remains unchanged. Test sources and outputs are authored at runtime in a temporary directory and removed; no drawing fixture is committed.

sourceBindings.fixtureRecipe: generateRootMLeaderStyleControl in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp emits group 90=0 in the AcDbMLeaderStyle subclass, group 92=25, two root dictionary entries, existing typed references and opaque group-302 tags; ASCII and binary inputs are generated locally from scratch.

limitations: The evidence qualifies one authored AC1027 adapter transaction only. It does not prove independent producer variation, native max-leader-points meaning, rendering, cross-version support, DWG editing, complete MLEADERSTYLE coverage, consumer acceptance or full document closure.
No support claim is promoted; the support ledger remains closed.
